stem:
Meera fills a tall plastic bottle with water and makes three small holes at different heights on the side of the bottle. Water spurts out from each hole.
What does this show about the pressure exerted by the water?

options.text: Water exerts pressure only downward on the bottom of the bottle.
Water exerts pressure on the side walls of the bottle, and this pressure increases with depth.
Water exerts pressure only when the bottle is shaken.
Water exerts equal pressure at every point in the bottle.

teacher.key_rationale: Water escaping through holes in the side wall shows that the liquid pushes on the side walls, not just downward; the stream from the lowest hole travels farthest, showing pressure increases with depth. Hence B.
